123    /**
124     * Generates a random Austrian Social Security number.
125     *
126     * @see https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sozialversicherungsnummer#.C3.96sterreich
127     *
128     * @return string
129     */
130    public static function ssn(?\DateTime $birthdate = null)
131    {
132        $birthdate = $birthdate ?? DateTime::dateTimeThisCentury();
133
134        $birthDateString = $birthdate->format('dmy');
135
136        do {
137            $consecutiveNumber = (string) self::numberBetween(100, 999);
138
139            $verificationNumber = (
140                (int) $consecutiveNumber[0] * 3
141                    + (int) $consecutiveNumber[1] * 7
142                    + (int) $consecutiveNumber[2] * 9
143                    + (int) $birthDateString[0] * 5
144                    + (int) $birthDateString[1] * 8
145                    + (int) $birthDateString[2] * 4
146                    + (int) $birthDateString[3] * 2
147                    + (int) $birthDateString[4] * 1
148                    + (int) $birthDateString[5] * 6
149            ) % 11;
150        } while ($verificationNumber == 10);
151
152        return sprintf('%s%s%s', $consecutiveNumber, $verificationNumber, $birthDateString);
153    }
